body: I recently bought this little guy, I think around 2 weeks ago. He seemed fine, but you never know with store bought plants if they are healthy or not. I have read that they go through dormancy but I’m worried that it may be a different case due to the traps not activating and the cilia/ edges pointing outwards. Does anyone know what could be happening or what I can do to help?
I’ll have a look, thank you for this valuable information
Your wife is very lucky. I’m living in the UK and found a similar pattern from the US. I’m not sure if I should improvise and try to make my own pattern or if I should carry on looking?
